source: Claude API reference list prices as cached on 2026-11-03 (see docs/07-agents/pixel-art-pipeline.md, section 3)
caveats: Estimates use API list prices. On a subscription plan they are API-equivalent figures, not billed amounts.
Cache writes cost 1.25x the input rate for the 5 minute cache and 2x for the 1 hour cache. When a transcript has no 5m/1h split, all cache writes are priced as 5 minute writes.
The Haiku cache-read rate (0.01) is unverified and assumed to be 0.1x the input rate.
Model matching is by substring (opus, sonnet, haiku) of the model id in the transcript. An unknown model is priced at 0 and reported as unpriced.
Fast mode, batch discounts, long-context surcharges and tool-specific fees (for example web search) are not modelled.
Wall-clock is last minus first transcript timestamp and includes any time the agent waited, for example on CI.
